title: Berlin vs Munich: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Berlin for history, nightlife, and budget travelers. Munich for beer culture, Alpine day trips, and Oktoberfest. Budget: Berlin €50–80/day vs Munich €70–110/day.

categories.name: Daily Budget
categories.summary: Berlin is 25–35% cheaper than Munich. Hostel dorms €15–28, street food from €3, döner kebab €4–6.

categories.name: Beer Culture
categories.summary: Munich's Hofbräuhaus, 60+ beer gardens, and Oktoberfest are unmatched. Berlin has a solid craft beer scene but is no contest for the beer hall experience.

categories.name: History & Museums
categories.summary: Berlin wins with the Holocaust Memorial, East Side Gallery, Museum Island, Checkpoint Charlie, and the Topography of Terror. Munich's Deutsches Museum is world-class but Berlin's historical density is unmatched.

categories.name: Nightlife
categories.summary: Berlin is the world capital of electronic music. Berghain, Tresor, and Watergate operate in a different league from anything in Munich.

categories.name: Day Trips
categories.summary: Munich wins: Neuschwanstein (2h), Salzburg (1.5h), Zugspitze (1.5h), Dachau (45min). Berlin has Potsdam and Sachsenhausen but can't match Alpine access.

categories.name: City Walkability
categories.summary: Munich's compact Altstadt is genuinely strollable. Berlin is vast — 9x the area of Paris — and requires significant time in transit.

categories.name: Food Scene
categories.summary: Berlin for multicultural diversity and budget value (döner kebab, Vietnamese, Turkish). Munich for Bavarian tradition (Weisswurst, pretzels, beer hall culture).

categories.name: Christmas Markets
categories.summary: Munich's Christkindlmarkt on Marienplatz is one of Germany's most beautiful. Both cities have great markets but Munich wins for atmosphere and snow probability.

categories.name: Family Friendliness
categories.summary: Munich is cleaner, more compact, and has the English Garden as a massive family space. Berlin has excellent museums for older kids but is grittier.

categories.name: Best Overall Value
categories.summary: Berlin offers more sights per euro than almost any major Western European capital. Free parks, affordable food, world-class free or cheap museums.

faq.question: Is Berlin or Munich better for first-time visitors?
faq.answer: Munich for traditional German experience; Berlin for history, nightlife, and diversity. Do both if you have 7+ days.

faq.question: Which is cheaper, Berlin or Munich?
faq.answer: Berlin is 25–35% cheaper across accommodation, food, and bars. Berlin €50–80/day vs Munich €70–110/day.

faq.question: Which has better nightlife?
faq.answer: Berlin by a massive margin. Berghain and the techno scene are globally unmatched.

faq.question: Which has better day trips?
faq.answer: Munich wins — Neuschwanstein, Salzburg, and the Zugspitze are world-class day trip destinations.
